## 🧐 About

This website showcases the results of the 2026 Let's Have A Relay, a conlang relay involving <span class="rainbow-word"><span style="color:#E40303;">a</span><span style="color:#FF8C00;">l</span><span style="color:#FFED00;">l</span><span style="color:#008026;">i</span><span style="color:#004DFF;">e</span><span style="color:#750787;">s</span></span> of the Internet's foremost source of information on Dromornithidae, the YouTube channel [Let's Have A Bouba](https://www.youtube.com/@LetsHaveaBouba){target="_blank" title="Go to Let's Have A Bouba on YouTube"}. There were two rings: the [Western Chielúú E Ring](./E-Ring) and the [Eastern Chiilúú I Ring](./I-Ring).

## 🎉 The big reveal

The results of the relay for both rings were revealed in a livestream on [Let's Have A Bouba](https://www.youtube.com/@LetsHaveaBouba){target="_blank" title="Go to Let's Have A Bouba on YouTube"} with many of the participants.

{{< video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zznr8AOA4kk >}}

## 😋 More is more

If your appetite for <span class="relayted">relay<span class="smush">-rela</span>ted</span> content has been whetted, have a gander at the page for the [2024 LTS Relay](https://keras-saryan.github.io/lts-relay/), which involved many of the same participants.
